name: Tu Hieu Pagoda
summary: A working monastery in the pines of Thủy Xuân, about 5 km from the centre, named by Tự Đức and the resting place of Nguyễn court eunuchs. Walk through the triple gate past the pond to the halls on the hillside. Go after Thien Mu for a quieter pagoda, and because Thích Nhất Hạnh was a novice here.
getThere: About 5 km, via Điện Biên Phủ and Lê Ngô Cát.
heroCaption: The triple gate and the pond at Tu Hieu

notice.title: No published fee or hours
notice.body: No ticket price or closing time is published for Từ Hiếu. Ask at the gate.

body: Từ Hiếu sits in Dương Xuân Thượng III village, Thủy Xuân ward, hidden in pines on the hillside, with a campus of about 8 acres and a curved ditch in front. It is about 5 km from the centre. The same page says the pagoda is the resting place of Nguyễn eunuchs, and that Tự Đức gave it the name Từ Hiếu.
Vietnam Tourism names it as the monastery where Thích Nhất Hạnh was a novice. Treat it as a working monastery after Thien Mu, not as a second citadel.
The city route is Điện Biên Phủ, then Lê Ngô Cát, then the sign. Go by motorbike, car, or taxi.

figures.caption: Ceramic roof tiles at Tu Hieu
figures.alt: Glazed roof tiles and ridge ornaments at Tu Hieu Pagoda

gettingThere: From the south bank, about 5 km: follow Điện Biên Phủ, turn onto Lê Ngô Cát, and take the sign for the pagoda.

legs.heading: From the south bank
legs.body: About 5 km by Điện Biên Phủ and Lê Ngô Cát.

admissionNote: Check on arrival. Neither the city page nor the national Hue page prints a fee.
